description: kith_core::auth::Identity derives #[derive(Debug)] (kith-core/src/auth.rs:12). The struct holds user_id, login_name, display_name, and node_name. Any {:?} formatting — in tracing events, panic messages, or test output — emits all fields including user_id and login_name. While these are not cryptographic secrets, they are stable identity correlators that should not appear in structured logs. Recommend replacing auto-derived Debug with a manual impl that redacts or omits sensitive fields. See audit scope: key-lifecycle.
title: Identity derives Debug: user_id/login_name may leak in logs/panics
